meta.fire_tax_note: Fire Tax matches MasonryRules square-root curve (3% at peg, 12% at or below a 10% drop). This sweep does not model Treasury bootstrap minting or gated expansion. Rebalance swaps that sell xTOMB are Fire-Tax-exempt when MasonryTaxHook.rangeManager is bound (sender == rangeManager). hyp_tax is the hypothetical USDG-marked tax if that bind were missing.
meta.redemption_value_definition: USDG received on redeem (quote side + xTOMB sold through the pool after Fire Tax, 30 bp fee and impact, after any rebalance costs already reflected in book depth) / USDG-marked deposit value
